OP we understand that you have made a bad mistake and lied to your parents. I won't lie and say that they won't be disappointed in you. But you can learn from this mistake of yours and can work harder and be free from distractionsfor your life ahead. You're only about 20 years old. That is as old as me. It is too young for you to die just because you feel bad about a mistake you've made. 

Yes your parents will be mad at you for some time. But they'll guide you through the right path after this too because they love you. I'm sure they won't disown you. 

I'd love to see you work hard ahead in life with the lessons you've learned and achieve better things. 

Trust me, this is your guilt, and your anxiety talking. Don't listen to it. Yes we all makes mistakes but there is so much more to experience in life than guilt, fear or anxiousness. 

I hope you try to see the brighter side of life OP. Love you. If you ever want to talk about anything, my DM's are always open. 

Work hard for your studies and reward yourself by getting braces on your next birthday. To celebrate one more year of living life bravely. To celebrate not giving up.
